packageRules.description: TanStack packages move together or not at all. react-start adds the `server` route option to react-router's own types by declaration merging, so bumping one without the other resolves two copies of router-core: the augmentation lands on the copy react-start pulled in, while the route files resolve the copy react-router pulled in, and every server route stops typechecking with 'server does not exist'. Nothing is wrong with the code when this happens, which is what makes it expensive to diagnose. Grouping them makes the partial bump unrepresentable.
